wip: v1.17.9 — start runtime circular-init fix (Layer.suspend) (checkpoint 33)

Typecheck-green exposed runtime module-init-order failures: the fork Service facades added cross-module
.defaultLayer/.node references that, combined with import cycles, evaluate to `undefined` at module load
(e.g. `Plugin.defaultLayer`/`Plugin.node` undefined while a consumer module's body runs). Tests now LOAD
and run (11 pass on the smoke set) but app-runtime import fails mid-init.

Fix (in progress): wrap the eager facade-layer compositions in Layer.suspend so the .defaultLayer reads
defer past the circular init. Done: src/project/bootstrap.ts defaultLayer, src/effect/app-runtime.ts
AppLayer, src/agent/agent.ts defaultLayer. Still failing at agent.ts node (LayerNode.make refs Plugin.node)
— LayerNode graphs need a different deferral than Layer.suspend, and more modules compose facade layers/
nodes at eval. Typecheck stays GREEN.

NEXT: finish the circular-init pass (defer/restructure facade .node compositions + break the import cycle
